title: VeraCrypt
pre: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$env:APPDATA\VeraCrypt" | Out-Null; Set-Content -Encoding utf8 "$env:APPDATA\VeraCrypt\Configuration.xml" '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><VeraCrypt><configuration><config key="Language">ru</config></configuration></VeraCrypt>'
reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\veracrypt /v VeraCryptEnableScreenProtection /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f; reg query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\veracrypt
